'''Tisht''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was located within the [[Tisht system/Legends|Tisht system]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] controlled by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The planet lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called [[the Dead Road]], which connected it to the worlds of [[M'Hanna]] and [[Saqqar]].<ref name="TEA" />

It was only possible to travel to Tisht with the authorization of the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]], the ruling [[Politics/Legends|political]] body of the Hutt species. As a result, outsiders knew almost nothing about the planet.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tisht was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square T-11.<ref name="TEA" />
